column1: # Ultima V clean engine QA scenario registry.
# Machine-readable system of record for stable reproduction inputs, expected
# sanitized results, required lanes, and the public specification revision.
# Validated by crates/u5-tui/tests/scenario_registry.rs; consumed by the
# RemoteGameDev u5-clean adapter nightly gate. See docs/qa-scenarios.md.
#   frontend           runtime | tui | bevy | dosbox | host
#   lanes              '|' separated: source asset bevy dosbox
#   spec_path          public spec path, or '*' when the scenario spans many documents
#   spec_commit        public spec commit the expectation was reviewed against
#   setup              deterministic command with {profile} and {out} placeholders, or a human procedure id
#   expected_value     64-hex sanitized manifest hash, '0', or checklist id
#   baseline_engine_commit  engine commit that produced expected_value
#   notes              free text without asset content
